claims.exact_statement: For every nonconstant genuine Boolean h on a finite uniform cube that is restriction-critical, and every relevant physical coordinate i with alpha_i=I_i(h), R(h)=H(h)/I(h) is at most G(alpha_i)=h_2(alpha_i)/alpha_i+(2/ln 2)min(alpha_i,1-alpha_i)/alpha_i. If R(h)>R_0=2+2/ln 2, then every alpha_i is at most kappa(R(h)) and at most e^3 2^{-R(h)}, where kappa is the inverse of G restricted to (0,1/2].
hypotheses: restriction-critical means Delta_i H >= (H/I) I_i for every relevant coordinate
claims.proof_source: CRITICAL_DIFFUSE_NORMAL_FORM.tex equations (1)-(5); REPORT.md Exact new theorem
claims.first_unproved_line: A uniform upper bound on R over the exponentially diffuse critical tensor-prime Boolean class.

claims.exact_statement: For every nonconstant genuine Boolean f with R(f)>R_0, there is a restriction-critical tensor-prime restriction descendant h with R(h)>=R(f) and max_i I_i(h)<=kappa(R(h))<=e^3 2^{-R(h)}<=e^3 2^{-R(f)}. Hence failure of FEI implies a genuine Boolean counterfamily with unbounded ratio inside this exponentially diffuse critical-prime class.
hypotheses: tensor-prime after deletion of dummy variables and constant factors

hypotheses: at least one relevant coordinate has influence at least fixed delta
